title: 7月汽油降价：消费者信心反降至90.8，就业担忧盖过油价红利？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Let's get straight to Bloomberg's Michael McKee, our international and economics and policy correspondent, live from Washington, G.C. Mike, what are you looking at?
segments.zh: 直接连线彭博的Michael McKee，我们的国际经济与政策记者，他在华盛顿。Mike，你在关注什么？

segments.en: Well, it's a little bit worse than even on first glance because the prior month June was revised up to 92.2 and it comes out at 90.8 for July.
segments.zh: 情况比初看更糟，因为6月数据上修至92.2，而7月为90.8。

segments.en: So a drop in confidence which wasn't totally expected because there was a feeling the earlier drop in gasoline prices this month might push confidence a little bit higher.
segments.zh: 信心下降有些意外，因为本月早些时候汽油价格下跌本应提振信心。

segments.en: Still waiting on the breakdown of other numbers from the consumer confidence.
segments.zh: 仍在等待消费者信心其他数据的细分。

segments.en: Now we've got the present situation. That falls to 114.9 from 116.4 and the expectations index rises a little bit.
segments.zh: 现状指数从116.4降至114.9，预期指数略有上升。

segments.en: 74.7 from 74.4, not really going to be a whole lot of difference in that.
But it does appear at this point that people were a little bit less confident about where things are going in the economy during the month of July, even though gasoline prices
segments.zh: 但看起来，尽管本月汽油价格大多下跌，人们对7月经济前景的信心有所减弱。

segments.en: fell for the most part during the month. Now the one thing that this survey is really based on is employment.
segments.zh: 这项调查主要基于就业情况。

segments.en: And right now the number of people who think the jobs are plentiful fell to 24.5 from 25.5
segments.zh: 认为就业机会充足的人数从25.5降至24.5。

segments.en: and hard to get, falls a little bit to 21.5 from 21.7.
segments.zh: 认为工作难找的人数从21.7微降至21.5。

segments.en: That's basically an improvement in no change in jobs.
segments.zh: 这基本意味着就业状况没有改善。
